excerpt.zh: 我们接触到了一个佣兵城邦。这些独立自主的军事专家会向各种国家，当然也包括我们国家，收费并租借佣兵舰队
excerpt.en: We have encountered a Mercenary Enclave. These independent military specialists may loan out Mercenary Fleets to empires including our own - for a fee.

texts.en: We have encountered a Mercenary Enclave. These independent military specialists may loan out Mercenary Fleets to empires including our own - for a fee.

texts.zh:
我们接触到了一个佣兵城邦。这些独立自主的军事专家会向各种国家，当然也包括我们国家，收费并租借佣兵舰队

如果我们选择租借一支佣兵舰队，我们会在指定时间内获得舰队的控制权。在该时间段内，城邦会增补损失的舰船，但不论如何我们都无法将佣兵舰队极其海军司令与我方舰船合并。
texts.en:
We have encountered a Mercenary Enclave. These independent military specialists may loan out Mercenary Fleets to empires including our own - for a fee.

If we choose to hire a Mercenary Fleet, we will retain control of it for a set period of time. During that time, the Enclave will attempt to reinforce the fleet when necessary, however neither a Mercenary Fleet nor its Admiral may be integrated with our own fleets.
